title: LigBench: A Unified and Human-Aligned Benchmark for LLM-based Research Idea Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), research idea generation has attracted increasing attention. Existing approaches enable LLMs to retrieve relevant literature and propose novel ideas for research areas. However, current evaluation practices for idea generation remain fragmented and lack objective standards, often relying on direct LLM scoring, which limits their ability to provide unified and reliable assessments across a coherent distribution of generated ideas. To address this challenge, we propose LigBench, an automated evaluation benchmark that enables fine-grained and reliable evaluation of AI research ideas, consistently applicable across different generation distributions. In addition, we introduce PAIR-IQ, a dataset tailored for training pairwise idea judgment models and serving as an auxiliary reference to support more objective comparative evaluation. translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，研究想法生成引起了越来越多的关注。现有方法使LLMs能够检索相关文献并为研究领域提出新颖想法。然而，当前对想法生成的评估实践仍然分散且缺乏客观标准，通常依赖于直接的LLM评分，这限制了其在生成想法的一致分布上提供统一和可靠评估的能力。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了LigBench，一个自动化评估基准，能够对AI研究想法进行细粒度且可靠的评估，并一致适用于不同的生成分布。此外，我们引入了PAIR-IQ，一个专门用于训练成对想法判断模型的数据集，并作为辅助参考以支持更客观的比较评估。大量实验表明，LigBench能够……（摘要未完整，但已翻译主要部分）
tldr: LigBench提出了一个统一且与人类对齐的自动化基准，结合PAIR-IQ数据集，实现了对LLM生成研究想法的细粒度、可靠且跨分布一致的评估。
en_tdlr: LigBench introduces a unified and human-aligned automated benchmark, combined with the PAIR-IQ dataset, to enable fine-grained, reliable, and distribution-consistent evaluation of LLM-generated research ideas.
